calls.title: Sony & GrowthBook Award Application Workshop
calls.summary: The team discussed a lightweight submission process for the Experimentation Culture Award, aiming for a 350-word summary that highlights PlayStation’s experimentation culture and growth. Elyse emphasized understanding the award category while Ashley and Elyse proposed a collaborative drafting approach. Tom agreed to draft initial content, focusing on safe sharing due to PlayStation's confidentiality needs. The team views the award as a strategic tool for recognition and recruitment. They confirmed a timeline aligned with internal reviews, discussing the growth in experimentation from 60 in 2023 to over 750, and the organizational adoption of experimentation across various pillars, along with a focus on safe player experiences. Communication via Slack was proposed for efficient progress.
calls.keywords: Experimentation Culture, Award Submission, PlayStation, Growth Metrics, AI Integration, Industry Recognition
